name: General Motors

What General Motors says to expect

  • Full year 2026: net income, operating cash flow and EPSThe company expects net income attributable to stockholders to be $8.9 billion to $9.5 billion; Automotive operating cash flow to be $17.3 billion to $20.3 billion; and EPS-diluted to be $9.72 to $10.72 based on its updated guidance and the impact of adjustments recorded year to date.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 20, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
